input.text: Company policy: supplier contracts may not include automatic renewal for more than 12 months, and any renewal must allow termination with at most 90 days' notice.

Contract clause 14.2: 'This agreement renews automatically for successive periods of 24 months unless either party gives written notice of termination at least 180 days before the end of the current period.'

decision.instructions: Does the clause comply with the policy?
